paper_title: AttentionInfluence Adopting Attention Head Influence for Weak-to-Strong   Pretraining Data Selection
caption: The statistics of clustering. The left is the clustering result of AttentionInfluence, the right part is that of FineWeb-Edu Classifier.
model_annotation: The two pie charts represent the clustering results of AttentionInfluence and FineWeb-Edu Classifier. The AttentionInfluence chart is divided into 15 slices, colored in shades of orange, red, and blue-green, with labels including "Teaching & resources" (15%, light green), "Science & technology education" (10%, green), "Health & Medicine" (22%, blue), and "History & Society" (23%, red), among others, and each slice is labeled with its corresponding category and count. The FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart is also divided into 15 slices, colored in similar shades, with labels such as "Teaching & resources" (17%, light green), "Science & technology education" (19%, green), "Health & Medicine" (19%, blue), and "History & Society" (19%, red), and each slice is labeled with its corresponding category and count. Both charts display their slices in a roughly descending order of size, with no legend or visually emphasized slices. The numerical labels within each slice provide the exact count for each category.
